summary: Implemented PublicationCoordinator (src/pcae/governance/publication/) against PEC-001 v1.0's frozen contract: the sole production owner of Publication Execution, external to interactive_workflow/**, cltr/**, and the PCAE phase-lifecycle tree, placed as a sibling package to pcae.governance (PEC-REQ-027). Consumes exactly two inputs -- an immutable PublicationReadinessPackage and an explicit PublicationAuthorizationEvent -- and performs PEC-REQ-051's fixed validation order (authorization presence, replay/idempotency check, package readiness, authorization applicability, authorization freshness) before any write. Publication Execution is atomic: canonical chgr-<uuid4> identity assignment and provenance/integrity capture occur in the same durable write (records/<record_id>.json), committed via an exclusive (O_CREAT | O_EXCL) marker create (published/<package_id>.json) that detects genuine concurrent races and rolls back the just-written record rather than silently duplicating a CHGR. Seven typed, fail-closed errors under a PublicationExecutionError/AtomicPublicationFailure hierarchy. Every attempt, accepted or refused, is durably recorded for audit. No CLI command was implemented (explicit phase No-Go). Two judgment calls disclosed in the phase report Sec.0: (JC-1) PublicationHandoff.is_ready()/validate_completeness() is called directly as a stateless delegation to the readiness authority IWC-001/143O already owns, verified by a dedicated AST-based test; (JC-2) the CHGR record this phase writes is reference-only, matching PublicationReadinessPackage's own design, not literally conformant to schema_resources/chgr/records/human_governance_record.schema.json's full-content shape -- disclosed as a genuine, pre-existing architectural gap deferred to a future contract revision. Updated .pcae/policy.toml to authorize the governance zone's two new, architecturally-justified dependencies (self, and the narrow read-only interactive_workflow delegation JC-1 documents). See docs/PHASE_144C_PUBLICATION_COORDINATOR_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
